mapper.sql: a.id, a.code, a.name, a.status, a.timezone, a.currency, a.create_time, a.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM scx_advertiser a INNER JOIN scx_user_subject_scope scope ON scope.subject_id = a.id AND scope.subject_type = 'ADVERTISER' AND scope.user_id = #{userId} WHERE a.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY a.name ASC
